info.title: Track B Multi-Agent Operations Copilot API
info.summary: Cited, domain-aware retrieval and Agentic RAG services.
info.description: FastAPI backend for the Track B Operations Copilot. Provides health and domain discovery, citation-grounded chat, evidence retrieval, guardrails, human-review routing, and optional LangSmith tracing. Request and response schemas below are the API contract.

get.description: Returns the service status and the domain identifiers accepted by domain-specific routes.

404.description: The requested domain was not found.

429.description: The client exceeded the request rate limit.

get.description: Returns display metadata and default questions for financial and non-financial domains.

404.description: The requested domain was not found.

429.description: The client exceeded the request rate limit.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key (only when the server sets API_AUTH_TOKEN).

get.summary: List the companies the financial corpus covers
get.description: Tickers with company name, sector and the fiscal years that have a filing in the corpus or the served index. Optional `sector` (names or slugs, comma-separated) narrows the list. The UI builds its ticker and year pickers from this.

404.description: The requested domain was not found.

429.description: The client exceeded the request rate limit.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key (only when the server sets API_AUTH_TOKEN).

post.description: Runs the selected financial QA technique over annual-report evidence. Optional ticker and year fields constrain the source evidence. The response includes a concise explanation of its evidence and citation checks.

404.description: The requested domain was not found.

429.description: The client exceeded the request rate limit.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key (only when the server sets API_AUTH_TOKEN).

post.description: Checks whether the question names a company, fiscal year and measure that the corpus covers. If something is missing, ambiguous or not available it returns `needs_clarification` with questions and options, plus `coverage` with the reason when the filings can't answer it, and keeps the partial request under `conversation_id` (30-minute TTL; in SQLite when `CONVERSATION_DB` is set, so it survives restarts, otherwise in memory). A complete question runs the financial agents; a report request runs the report pipeline after the user confirms. Advice, prediction and prompt-injection messages go straight to the guarded agent.

404.description: The requested domain was not found.

429.description: The client exceeded the request rate limit.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key (only when the server sets API_AUTH_TOKEN).

post.description: Runs the shared guarded Agentic RAG workflow for a non-financial domain. Supported domain identifiers are returned by `GET /domains`. Financial report QA uses the dedicated `/chat/financial_report_qa` operation. The response includes a concise explanation of its evidence and workflow checks.

404.description: The requested domain was not found.

429.description: The client exceeded the request rate limit.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key (only when the server sets API_AUTH_TOKEN).

post.description: Searches annual-report evidence and returns ranked records without generating an answer.

404.description: The requested domain was not found.

429.description: The client exceeded the request rate limit.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key (only when the server sets API_AUTH_TOKEN).

post.description: Searches a non-financial domain's corpus and returns ranked evidence records. Supported domain identifiers are returned by `GET /domains`; financial retrieval uses the dedicated `/retrieve/financial_report_qa` operation.

404.description: The requested domain was not found.

429.description: The client exceeded the request rate limit.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key (only when the server sets API_AUTH_TOKEN).

post.description: Hybrid dense + sparse search over the local Qdrant `docs_text` collection (text and OCR'd pages). `final_status` is `evidence_found`, `insufficient_evidence` or `tool_error`.

post.summary: Answer with the local multimodal pipeline
post.description: Input guard, retrieval, then a fail-closed answer from the configured provider (`extractive`, `ollama`, `transformers` or `llamacpp`). Unsafe input returns `refused`.
